about_the_game:
DAYDREAM: A Childhood Nostalgia Horror Game
A surreal co-op horror game where the places you once loved become the things you fear.

  • A journey through forgotten childhood
    Explore detailed, realistic environments inspired by childhood spaces like arcades, playplaces, and bedrooms. These locations once felt safe, but now something is off.

  • Built for immersion
    With high-quality visuals and a minimal interface, every space is designed to feel like a real memory. You’re not just playing a game, you're stepping into the past.

  • Play together or get left behind
    Daydream is a four-player co-op experience. Work with your team to solve puzzles, collect strange items, document entities, and find a way out. Going off alone could cost you everything.

  • A dream that slowly turns
    At first, the world feels calm and nostalgic. Familiar music, soft lighting, and whimsical colors create a comforting mood. But it doesn’t stay that way.

  • Hand-crafted liminal spaces
    Each level is designed by hand with no procedural generation. Childhood landmarks are reimagined as eerie, decaying places where nothing feels quite right.

  • Terrifying enemies that learn from you
    Every entity is unique. Some react to sound. Some follow you quietly. Each one is a puzzle, and your survival depends on paying attention and adapting.

  • Puzzle-solving with consequences
    Environmental puzzles are woven into each realm. Solving them unlocks new areas, but also new dangers. Your choices shape the experience.

  • Sound that guides and misleads
    A mix of eerie ambient sound and nostalgic melodies brings each environment to life. Sometimes comforting. Sometimes haunting.
